note: Two pins of one variable with different spans: OjamnDetalj (from 2018) over 2010..2020 is clipped to 2018..2020; Ojamn, delivered over the whole range, is ordered whole. Moved from `api/validate-pinned-uneven-span` when `validate` dropped `range_period_partially_covered` (#1836). Fails if the order stops clipping each binding to these days, reports another clip, or renders a clipped period differently.
